info.title: Mosaic Server API
info.description: Contract for the Go server. JSON uses camelCase; documented query aliases remain supported. All timestamps are Unix milliseconds. This contract version is independent of application release tags. Examples are fictional. The admin single-page application and its static files are not API operations.

post.description: Pulls at most 200 changed rows per entity, including deletion markers. Missing cursors start at zero. Response cursors advance to server time; truncation is not signalled, so an overfull batch can omit older changes on subsequent pulls. Clients must not assume repeated pulls guarantee a complete backfill.
